note: Adapted from the species description of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; in the original the entry is placed in Malaysiocapritermes under the name Procapritermes holmgreni; all three castes are described; synonymy lists, figure numbers and distribution records are omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate 12.4–12.6 long including the wings, 6.10–6.5 without wings, forewing 9.20–10.60 long, antennae 15-segmented; soldier total length 5.3–5.6, head rectangular, mandibles weakly asymmetrical and longer than the head length without mandibles; worker total length 3.80–5.00, antennae 14-segmented. Head and body setose in all three castes.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule golden yellow, brownish yellow anteriorly, fontanelle area pale yellow; antennae pale brown; mandibles nearly black; body and legs milk-white. Head moderately setose, body densely setose; total length 5.3–5.6. Head rectangular, sides weakly convex, longer than wide (length to mandibular base 1.49–1.66, maximum width 1.08–1.23); coronal suture extending from the posterior margin to slightly less than half the head length; head convex in profile, frons steeply inclined anteriorly at about 45°. Fontanelle transverse, situated slightly below the anterior margin of the frontal slope, margins brown. Antennae slender, 14-segmented, segments 2 and 3 subequal, segment 4 slightly shorter. Labrum subrectangular, longer than wide (width 0.20–0.23), anterior margin deeply incurved, anterolateral angles produced into long pointed processes, a few setae near the anterior margin and on the disc. Mandibles weakly asymmetrical, pointed apically, longer than the head length without mandibles (length 1.75–1.90). Postmentum short, clavate, waist below midlength, with three pairs of setae near the anterior margin (length 0.63–0.78, maximum width 0.33–0.38, waist width 0.21–0.30). Legs slender and setose, tibial apical spurs 3:2:2; abdomen elongate, cerci 2-segmented, without styli.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head, postclypeus, antennae and labrum pale yellow, thorax milk-white, abdomen transparent and appearing grey through the gut contents; head and body rather densely setose; total length 3.80–5.00. Head subcircular, wider than long (length to mandibular base 0.70–0.80, width 0.95–1.00). Frontal plate small, oval, with a translucent spot at the middle. Postclypeus setose and arched, about two-fifths as long as wide. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 4 shortest, segment 3 slightly shorter than segment 2.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule dark brown, postclypeus, antennae and pronotum brown; wings brown; legs yellowish brown; abdominal dorsum dark brown, venter paler. Head densely covered with short setae and bearing several long setae; anterior and posterior margins of the wings setose, membrane with a few setae apically. Total length with wings 12.4–12.6, 6.10–6.5 without wings. Head subcircular, frontal plate area depressed, width including the eyes greater than the length (length to mandibular base 0.70–0.80, width including the eyes 1.06–1.10). Frontal plate small and narrow, slit-like to oval (length 0.07–0.09, width 0.03–0.04). Eyes circular and prominent (maximum diameter 0.28–0.29). Ocelli oval (length 0.10–0.15, width 0.05–0.10), separated from the eye by 0.05–0.08. Postclypeus arched, setose, without a median line (length 0.16–0.20, width 0.40–0.50). Antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 shortest. Labrum dome-shaped, wider than long (length 0.35, width 0.40). Pronotum narrower than the head, anterior margin weakly convex, each shoulder with a dark brown spot (length 0.47–0.53, width 0.78–0.88). Forewing including the wing scale 9.20–10.60 long, hindwing 8.20–9.80; cubitus of the forewing with 9–10 branches reaching the posterior margin, media of the hindwing with 5 branches. Abdomen elongate, cerci 2-segmented.
